    - a: First number
    - b: Second number

number_theory_totient: Computes Euler's totient function phi(n) - count of integers 1 to n coprime with n.
    - n: Positive integer

number_theory_divisors: Finds all positive divisors of n.
    - n: Positive integer

You can call multiple tools in a single turn:

<tool_calls>
<tool_call>
<name>tool_name_1</name>
<args>{"param1": value1, "param2": value2}</args>
</tool_call>
<tool_call>
<name>tool_name_2</name>
<args>{"param3": value3}</args>
</tool_call>
</tool_calls>

<tool_calls>

<args>{"expr": "75 * 2"}</args>
</tool_call>

arithmetic: 150

</tool_calls>

arithmetic: 628.89
Assistant: The interest earned is $628.89.
